paite: Huan Benjamin gam a Benjamin suan a mi khat mihat leh hangsan mahmah a-om a, amin Kish ahi. Amah Abiel tapa, Zeror tapa, Bekorath tapa, Aphiah tapa ahi.
heading: Saul In Samuel Akimuhpih
english: Now there was a man of Benjamin, whose name was Kish the son of Abiel, the son of Zeror, the son of Becorath, the son of Aphiah, the son of a Benjamite, a mighty man of valor.

paite: Ama'n tapa khat anei a, amin Saul ahi. Tangval deihhuaitak ahi a, Israel mite lak ah amah sang a deihhuaizaw himhim a-om kei. Kuamah aliangzang khup leng a-om kei hi.
english: He had a son whose name was Saul, an impressive young man; and there was not among the children of Israel a more handsome person than he. From his shoulders and upward he was taller than any of the people.

paite: Saul pa Kish sabiltungte amang hi. Kish in atapa Saul kiang ah, "Thou inla, sikha khat pi inla sabiltungte va zong dih ve," achi hi.
english: The donkeys of Kish, Saul’s father, were lost. Kish said to Saul his son, “Now take one of the servants with you, and arise, go look for the donkeys.”

paite: Huchi in Ephraim tanggam ah avak a, Shalisha gam ah avak hi. Himahleh amu kei uh. Huchi in Shalim gam ah avak ua, huai ah leng amu kei uh. Benjamin mite gam ah avak nawn ua, himahleh amu tuan kei uhi.
english: He passed through the hill country of Ephraim, and passed through the land of Shalishah, but they didn’t find them. Then they passed through the land of Shaalim, and they weren’t there. Then he passed through the land of the Benjamites, but they didn’t find them.

paite: Zuph gam atun un Saul in akiang a om asikha kiang ah, "Kisa dih, i pai nawn mai ding, ahuchih keileh ka pa'n sabiltungte awlmoh nawn lou in ei hon ngaihtuah zaw kha ding,” achi hi.
english: When they had come to the land of Zuph, Saul said to his servant who was with him, “Come! Let’s return, lest my father stop caring about the donkeys and be anxious for us.”

paite: Ama'n akiang ah, "Ngai in, hiai khua ah Pathian mipa a-om a, mizahtakhuaitak ahi. Agen peuhmah ahong tung ngeingei nak hi. Kisa in, huai ah i va hoh ding, i hohna lampi ahon hilhthei zenzen khakleh," achi hi.
english: The servant said to him, “Behold now, there is a man of God in this city, and he is a man who is held in honor. All that he says surely happens. Now let’s go there. Perhaps he can tell us which way to go.”

paite: Huchi in Saul in asikha kiang ah, "Ahi na a, ngai dih, hoh hita lehang, huai mi a ding in bang i tawi dia? I bawm ah lah tanghou a-om nawn kei. Pathian mipa kipahman tawi ding a-om het kei hi. Bang i nei a eita?" achi hi.
english: Then Saul said to his servant, “But behold, if we go, what should we bring the man? For the bread is spent in our sacks, and there is not a present to bring to the man of God. What do we have?”

paite: Sikha in Saul adawng nawn a, "Ngai in, dangka shekel mun li a khen mun khat ka tawi lai hi. Hiai i hohna ding a hon hilh man ding in Pathian mipa ka pe ding," achi hi.
english: The servant answered Saul again and said, “Behold, I have in my hand the fourth part of a shekel of silver. I will give that to the man of God, to tell us our way.”

paite: Tuma siah Israelte lak a mi'n Pathian dot a-utleh, "Kisa dih, mutheipa kiang ah i hoh ding,” achi nak uh. Tulai a zawlnei achih uh tuma lam a mutheipa achih uh ahi.
english: (In earlier times in Israel, when a man went to inquire of God, he said, “Come! Let’s go to the seer;” for he who is now called a prophet was before called a seer.)

paite: Huchi in Saul in asikha kiang ah, "Hoih geih e, va hoh peuhmah ni," achi hi. Huchi in Pathian mipa omna khua ah ahohta uhi.
english: Then Saul said to his servant, “Well said. Come! Let’s go.” So they went to the city where the man of God was.

paite: Mual a kho zotna lampi a apaitouh lai un nungak tui tawi dia hong kuante amu ua, akiang uah, "Hiai ah mutheipa a-om hia?" achi uhi.
english: As they went up the ascent to the city, they found young maidens going out to draw water, and said to them, “Is the seer here?”

paite: Amau adawng ua, "Om mah e, ngai in, na ma uah apai, kin un, tuni in khua ah ana hoh hi. Tuni in mun sang ah mite akithoih uh.
english: They answered them and said, “He is. Behold, he is before you. Hurry now, for he has come today into the city; for the people have a sacrifice today in the high place.

paite: Khua a na luttouhtak un mun sang a an ne dia ahoh ma in na va mu ngal ding uh. Kithoihna vualzawlpa ding ahih ziak in atun mateng mipi'n an ane kei ding uh. Huai khit chiang in amisapte un an ane zel uhi. Huaiziak in hohtou meng unla, na va mu pah ding uh," achi uhi.
english: As soon as you have come into the city, you will immediately find him before he goes up to the high place to eat; for the people will not eat until he comes, because he blesses the sacrifice. Afterwards those who are invited eat. Now therefore go up; for at this time you will find him.”

paite: Huchi in khua ah ahohtou ua, khua alut uleh, ngai in, Samuel mun sang a hoh ding in amau akituahpih hi.
english: They went up to the city. As they came within the city, behold, Samuel came out toward them to go up to the high place.

paite: Saul hong ma ni khat in Samuel kiang ah TOUPA akilak a:
english: Now Yahweh had revealed to Samuel a day before Saul came, saying,

paite: "Zingchiang in hichi hun in Benjamin gam a pan na kiang ah mi khat ka hon hohsak dia, ka mi Israelte tung a heutu ding in thau na nilh ding ahi. Ama'n Philistia mite khut a pan ka mite ahondam ding. Akikou husa uh ka kiang ahong tun tak ziak in ka mite zaw ka limsak ahi," achi hi.
english: “Tomorrow about this time I will send you a man out of the land of Benjamin, and you shall anoint him to be prince over my people Israel. He will save my people out of the hand of the Philistines; for I have looked upon my people, because their cry has come to me.”

paite: Samuel in Saul amuh in TOUPA'N akiang ah, "En dih, na kiang a ka mi gen; amah mah in ka mite tung ah vai ahawm ding," achi hi.
english: When Samuel saw Saul, Yahweh said to him, “Behold, the man of whom I spoke to you! He will have authority over my people.”

paite: Huchi in kulh kongpi ah Saul in Samuel ava naih a, "Mutheipa inn koi lai a om ahia, hon hilh dih ve," achi hi.
english: Then Saul approached Samuel in the gateway, and said, “Please tell me where the seer’s house is.”

paite: Samuel in Saul adawng a, "Kei huai mutheipa ka hi. Ka ma ah mun sang lam zuan in pai inla, tuni in ka kiang ah an na ne ding hi. Zingchiang zingsang in ka hon paisak ding. Na lungtang a om tengteng leng ka hon hilh ding.
english: Samuel answered Saul and said, “I am the seer. Go up before me to the high place, for you are to eat with me today. In the morning I will let you go and will tell you all that is in your heart.

paite: Ni thum paita a mang na sabiltung thu lunghimoh ke'n. Muh ahita uh. Israelte lunggulh kua tung ah ahia a-om? Nang leh na pa inn a mi tengteng tung ah ahi kei maw?" achi hi.
english: As for your donkeys who were lost three days ago, don’t set your mind on them, for they have been found. For whom does all Israel desire? Is it not you and all your father’s house?”

paite: Saul in adawng a, "Israel nam lak a neupen, Benjamin nam ka hi kei maw? Ka inkuan leng Benjamin inkuan tengteng lak a neupen ahi kei maw? Bangchidan a hichidan ka kiang a gen na hia?" achi hi.
english: Saul answered, “Am I not a Benjamite, of the smallest of the tribes of Israel? And my family the least of all the families of the tribe of Benjamin? Why then do you speak to me like this?”

paite: Samuel in Saul leh asikha api a, mikhual indan ah apilut a, achialte uh, mi sawmthum lak ah mun zahtakhuai ah atusak hi.
english: Samuel took Saul and his servant and brought them into the guest room, and made them sit in the best place among those who were invited, who were about thirty persons.

paite: Samuel in anhuanmi kiang ah, "Na kiang a koihtuam ding ka chih, tantuan ka hon piak pen hon la dih," achi hi.
english: Samuel said to the cook, “Bring the portion which I gave you, of which I said to you, ‘Set it aside.’”

paite: Huchi in anhuanmi in aphei leh atung a om ahon tawi a, Saul ma ah alui hi. Samuel in, "En dih, ka na koihtuam, um inla ne in. Ahun sehsa a dia hiai mite ka chialkhawm lai a ka hon sehsak him ahi, ka na chita ngal a," achi hi. Huchi in huai ni in Saul in Samuel toh ankuang a-umkhawm uhi.
english: The cook took up the thigh, and that which was on it, and set it before Saul. Samuel said, “Behold, that which has been reserved! Set it before yourself and eat; because it has been kept for you for the appointed time, for I said, ‘I have invited the people.’” So Saul ate with Samuel that day.

paite: Mun sang a pan khua ahong paisuk un intung ah Saul in Samuel ahoupih hi.
english: When they had come down from the high place into the city, he talked with Saul on the housetop.

paite: Zingkhangpi in athou a; nisuah kuan in Samuel in intung a om Saul asam hi. "Thou in, ka hon paisakta ding," achi hi. Huchi in anih un apaikhia ua, Saul leh Samuel apawtta uh.
heading: Samuel In Saul Thuhilhna
english: They arose early; and about daybreak, Samuel called to Saul on the housetop, saying, “Get up, that I may send you away.” Saul arose, and they both went outside, he and Samuel, together.

paite: Khonawl atunsuk un Samuel in Saul kiang ah, "Sikhapa i malam ah paisak inla, ama'n hon paipel zoh chiang in, nang bel khawl tadih in, Pathian thu ka hon hilh ding," achi hi.
english: As they were going down at the end of the city, Samuel said to Saul, “Tell the servant to go on ahead of us.” He went ahead, then Samuel said, “But stand still first, that I may cause you to hear God’s message.”
